fusions.name: Tight Formation
fusions.desc: Looses 3 darts of water in a tight spread, each dealing 6 damage. It holds 4 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Rehearsed Pass
fusions.desc: A thrown strike that deals 28 damage, up to 2 times that at maximum range, and always lands as a critical hit. Its damage rises 8% for each ally beside you, up to 32%.

fusions.name: Drilled Turn
fusions.desc: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities that is still waiting, chosen at random, and raises your movement speed by 20% for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Schooled Instinct
fusions.desc: Once every 10 seconds, a strike that fails to crit is rolled again and the second roll stands. Its effect grows 10% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 4 allies.
